fato_historico: 1875: The Treaty of Saint Petersburg between Japan and Russia is ratified, providing for the exchange of Sakhalin for the Kuril Islands.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider the flow of give and take in your life. Much like ancient territories were once thoughtfully balanced through diplomacy, you may find that today is a perfect time to negotiate personal boundaries. Your Libra spirit is naturally inclined toward fairness, so trust your ability to restore equilibrium in any relationship that feels slightly misaligned right now.
frase_do_dia: True balance is found in the graceful exchange of hearts and minds.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your most balanced and harmonious dreams.
conselho: Communicate your needs gently but firmly to maintain your inner peace.
